name: searchgres-workspace
description: Workspace root for searchgres. Not published.

scripts.build: ./bun run --filter searchgres build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/protocol build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/filter build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/presentation build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/client build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/server build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/cli build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/mcp build
scripts.compile: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && ./bun run build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/cli compile && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/server compile && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/mcp compile
scripts.compile:all: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && ./bun run build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/cli compile:all && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/server compile:all && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/mcp compile:all
scripts.typecheck: ./bun run --filter searchgres build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/protocol build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/filter build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/presentation build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/client build && ./bun run --filter searchgres typecheck && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/protocol typecheck && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/filter typecheck && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/presentation typecheck && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/client typecheck && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/server typecheck && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/cli typecheck && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/mcp typecheck
scripts.test:unit: ./bun run --filter searchgres build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/protocol build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/filter build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/presentation build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/client build && ./bun run --filter searchgres test:unit && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/protocol test:unit && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/filter test:unit && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/presentation test:unit && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/client test:unit && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/server test:unit && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/cli test:unit && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/mcp test:unit && ./bun test ./scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.test:db: ./bun run compile && ./bun run --filter searchgres test:db && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/server test:db
scripts.check: ./bun run check:filter-grammar && ./bun run typecheck && ./bun run lint && ./bun run test:unit
scripts.pg:up: ./bun run pg:build && docker run -d --name searchgres-postgres -e POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD=trust -p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432 searchgres-postgres
